name: c-empty-summer-field-dusk
prompt: A tall portrait frame of an empty school playing field on a midsummer evening around the year 2000, the grass gone long and seeded at the edges, a child's bicycle tipped over on its side in the grass near the bottom of the picture, front wheel slightly turned, nobody anywhere. A low line of distant hedges, a goalpost with no net and the roofs of semi-detached houses sit small along the horizon about a third of the way up, and everything above is open sky fading from soft apricot near the rooftops through a milky lilac into a pale washed-out blue at the top, with no clouds, birds or objects in the upper half. Shot from standing height on a cheap home video camera resting on a fence post and forgotten, perfectly still, slightly soft and never quite in focus, with the slightly muted, warm, low-resolution colour of old consumer tape: a gentle bloom around the bright sky near the horizon, reds and greens pushed a little too warm, fine analogue noise in the shadows of the grass and a faint softness at the edges. The feeling is the quiet moment after everyone has been called in for tea, contented and a little sad, the last few seconds before the tape runs out. No text, no date stamp, no recording symbols, no lettering anywhere in the picture.
